issue.title: test_prompt_tab_focus_steal fails under xdist with FrontmatterPanel.on_mount NoMatches
issue.description: Phase sase-1fu.1 note #1 (2026-10-03): the guarded check's scoped suite failed tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py, and the same file passed alone (5 passed). Phase sase-1fu.4 note #1 (2026-10-04): guarded check a02d6119e8519df3ad9af681b421ea69 had 6,348 passed, 5 failed, and 5 errors, all five cases in that file, each with a FrontmatterPanel.on_mount NoMatches(#frontmatter-raw) teardown error. The same 5 failed / 5 errors reproduced with `pytest -n 4 --dist=worksteal -q tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py` on commit 2307212bcd (18.95s). sase-1fu did not edit frontmatter_panel.py. This land agent did not re-run the file. The serial pass and the xdist failure are the two phase notes, so this is a flake rather than a streaming defect. Closed task sase-pe fixed a different node (test_enter_loads_raw_definition_and_binds_source) with the same missing-widget symptom. Open epic sase-j7 tracks the parallel-lane flake class but does not name this node.

evidence.note: Independent serial (non-xdist) reproduction at master 404b0e2ac2 by the sase-1eq.5.1 land agent: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/ace/tui/test_macro_browser_load_keymap.py tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py' failed 3 of 3 runs (full run: 5 failed + 5 errors). The first failure, test_tab_after_background_refresh_stays_on_agents[refresh_display-insert], hits the wait_for 5s timeout with FrontmatterPanel.on_mount (frontmatter_panel.py:206) NoMatches('#frontmatter-raw') on FrontmatterPanel(id='frontmatter-panel', classes='hidden'), then DuplicateIds / AcePageGroup isolation-leak teardown errors. test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py alone passed (5 passed, 12.5s). The trigger is order-dependent state left by the preceding macro-browser keymap file, not xdist itself: this two-file serial command is a deterministic repro for the fixer. Phases sase-1eq.5.1.3 (notes #1, #3) and sase-1eq.5.1.6 (note #2) recorded the same stack on tests/ace/tui/test_app_title.py::test_on_mount_refines_title_to_resolved_version and tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_limit_keys.py::test_agents_tab_ctrl_j_does_not_rewrite_artifacts_query (both pass in isolation), so check a FrontmatterPanel.on_mount fix against those nodes too. sase-1eq.5.1 did not cause this: its tui-contracts phase saw the suite fail on a clean base before any epic commit.
